mechanism_narrative: Because WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain deeply below baseline while RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline, the area is still in a low-commuting regime that should keep discretionary retail visits suppressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not below its last-28-day mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay more than 45 points below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL falls week-on-week after staying elevated, the reduced stay-at-home pressure frees time for out-of-home shopping trips, causing RETAIL_REC to rise within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines by at least 2 points from the prior weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops week-on-week by at least 2 points.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays less depressed than RETAIL_REC, routine errand traffic is recovering faster than discretionary shopping, and that spillover should lift retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM is closer to baseline than RETAIL_REC throughout the same window.

mechanism_narrative: A further downward break in TRANSIT below its current depressed level indicates tighter movement constraints or weaker network service, which should reduce retail access and push RETAIL_REC lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 3 points below the latest weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the week after TRANSIT drops further below its current weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS continues to recover while RETAIL_REC remains far below baseline, outdoor discretionary activity is crowding out indoor shopping trips, so retail-and-recreation mobility will stay weak over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 3 points week-on-week while RETAIL_REC stays below -60
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -60 within 14 days after PARKS increases by at least 3 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward drift in PARKS over four weeks is a seasonal substitute for indoor shopping, so retail-and-recreation mobility will underperform its recent average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days despite PARKS continuing to recover.

mechanism_narrative: As WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both move closer to baseline together, shared weekday travel will feed discretionary stops and lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT each rise at least 2 points from their latest weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over 28 days after both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise week-on-week by at least 2 points.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and WORKPLACES remain below baseline, people consolidate trips and avoid discretionary outings, keeping RETAIL_REC below its recent level over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays positive and WORKPLACES stay more than 45 points below baseline.
